reference_stats.key_excerpt: The committee's review of the literature did not support the conclusion that social media causes changes in adolescent health at the population level. Nevertheless, there are potential harms associated with the platforms such as the ability to encourage unhealthy social comparisons

Up to 95% of young people aged 13-17 report using a social media platform. Nearly two thirds of teenagers report using social media every day and one third report using social media “almost constantly.”

Using social media is not inherently beneficial or harmful to young people. Adolescents' lives online both reflect and impact their offline lives.
